instruction: I would like to set the default video playback speed in Chrome to 1.5x for all websites. This would save me a lot of time when watching educational content, as I wouldn't need to manually adjust the speed on each video player.

metadata.explanation: This task is infeasible because Chrome does not provide a global setting to change default video playback speed. Playback speed is controlled by individual video players (YouTube, Vimeo, etc.) and cannot be set universally through Chrome settings.

llm_judge_reasons: Task is correctly identified as infeasible - Chrome does not provide a native global setting for default video playback speed
Video playback speed is controlled by individual video players (YouTube, Vimeo, HTML5 players) and cannot be set universally through Chrome settings
The 'infeasible' evaluator is the appropriate classification for this impossible task
No verification logic is needed or possible since the task cannot be completed within Chrome's native capabilities
